reports.verdict: Refining windfall and a $20 billion 2027 buyback plan lifted shares.

reasons.label: Big refining rebound

reasons.label: Huge 2027 buyback

reasons.label: Strong cash, less debt

reports.verdict: Refining-driven profit beat expectations, lifting shares modestly despite lower production and oil prices.

reasons.label: Beat on estimates

reasons.label: Cash and debt gains

reports.verdict: Revenue beat estimates and AbbVie raised its outlook again, lifting the stock modestly.

reasons.label: Revenue beat estimates

reasons.label: Immunology drugs surging

reports.verdict: Search traffic is collapsing and Reddit warned of fewer users ahead, outweighing strong profits.

reasons.label: Warning of user drop
reasons.text: Reddit said daily users could fall by a low-double-digit percentage in Q4 if trends hold.

reasons.label: Google traffic keeps shrinking

reasons.label: U.S. users shrinking

reports.verdict: Beat on the quarter, but a weak Q4 outlook and PC slump spooked investors.

reports.verdict: Investors cheered a big profit beat and a higher full-year outlook.

reports.verdict: Investors cheered a big revenue beat, a smaller loss and a raised delivery outlook.

reasons.label: Resilient consumer spending
